annotations.title: What to do before, on arrival, during the stay, and before leaving

description: 한국 여행 안내·관광 통계 (Korea Basics): List what a visitor has to deal with at one stage of a trip to Korea (before, arrival, stay, departure, or all): each rule with its value as the government document states it, whether something is filed online in advance, the check date, and the page URL. With a country, the values that depend on nationality (visa-free stay, K-ETA, automated immigration lanes) are for that passport. With an arrival date and nights, values are the ones in force on that date, and the result adds the public holidays and festivals that fall in the stay. The arrival stage includes the order of the counters at the airport. Values only, no decision about a person's eligibility.

country.description: Optional passport country: a country name in any of the site's languages or an ISO code, e.g. "Japan", "日本", "US", "DEU".

nights.description: Optional length of stay in nights, used with arrival_date.
